the ammo readout turns red at the same quarter-magazine Halo 3 uses everywhere: 8 of 32 on the Assault Rifle, 18 of 72 here (and 18 of 60 on the SMG). Same either way, because the port's magazine is 72 balanced or not.

0xE128 is one of only two unclaimed weapon-shaped glyphs in the shared Halo 3 / ODST icon font. NOTE: this field does NOT draw the pickup prompt -- proved by setting it to the gravity hammer's 0xE120 and seeing no change in game. It is kept because it is the weapon's own icon codepoint and the donor's would be wrong, but the prompt icon comes from somewhere else: most likely the chud's Sequence Index into ui\chud itmaps\weapon_scematics, which the port inherited from the Assault Rifle along with its chud.

Halo 2.desc: SAW carried from Halo 4 into Halo 2, built on the cut GPMG and balanced through the Assault Rifle into Halo 3 and the SMG out of it. It owns its own first-person animations, so its reload can be retimed.
